question: What is the attendance requirement to sit in the Major exam?
expected_answer: Students are allowed to appear in the exams even if attendance is below 75%, but students not meeting 75% attendance must score at least a C grade to pass; otherwise they get an F grade (Sec. 4.1.9). Check the 2024-25 attendance amendment for any change.

question: What are the minimum and maximum credits a UG student can register for in a semester?
expected_answer: Minimum 12 credits and maximum 25 credits per semester (Sec. 12.2).

question: What is the maximum duration allowed to complete the B.Tech. program?
expected_answer: 14 registered semesters (Sec. 11.4).

question: Within how many days must I apply for a make-up examination and to whom?
expected_answer: Within ten days from the date of the missed exam, to the Dean (Academics) through the course instructor, with medical documents (Sec. 8).

question: How many days of short leave can a UG student take on medical grounds?
expected_answer: A maximum of 10 days on medical grounds (and 5 days for any other valid reason) during a semester (Sec. 15.2).

question: How many grade points is an A- grade worth?
expected_answer: 9 grade points (Excellent) (Table 5.1).

question: How many credits must a general category B.Tech student earn by the end of the second semester to continue in the program?
expected_answer: 18 credits for GEN/OBC/GEN-EWS (14 for SC/ST/PD); otherwise the student may restart once or registration is terminated (Sec. 11.5).

question: What is the maximum number of credits I can register for in the summer term?
expected_answer: A maximum of 8 credits (Sec. 12.1).

question: Is branch change allowed for B.Tech students admitted in 2026?
expected_answer: No. Branch change in UG programs is discontinued from Academic Year 2026-27 (earlier rule needed CGPA >= 8.5 after semester II, 7.5 for SC/ST/PwD).

question: What happens if a student is absent for four or more weeks in a semester?
expected_answer: Absence of four or more weeks leads to automatic cancellation of registration / automatic withdrawal from that semester (Sec. 3.5 and 15.3).
